summary: Active Home Switching (property_id-scoped retrofit for rooms/assets/projects/inventory) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_active_home_switching.py). REGRESSION on demo (active=My Home): /api/hi/rooms/map=5 rooms, /api/hi/assets>=1, /api/hi/projects=3, /api/hi/inventory=3, /api/hi/dashboard 200, /api/hi/maintenance/home 200, /api/hi/documents 200, /api/hi/chat/conversations + /message returns reply. ACTIVE SWITCH: POST /api/hi/account/properties/{Lake Cabin id}/activate → GET projects=0, inventory=0, rooms/map=0 (all EMPTY); maintenance/documents still 200 (user-scoped, acceptable per spec). Exactly one is_active at a time verified (only Lake Cabin=true after activate; only My Home=true after restore). Property-scoped creates verified: created a TEST_ toolbox item and a project while Lake Cabin was active; both invisible when switching back to My Home (proves no leakage). Frontend UI (mobile 390x844, /home-intel/account): 'Set active' button (testID home-activate-<id>) moves ACTIVE tag correctly (My Home → Lake Cabin → back to My Home). Navigating to My Projects while Lake Cabin active shows empty state 'No projects yet' with 0 proj-<id> cards; My Toolbox shows empty state 'Your toolbox is empty' with 0 inv-item cards. Switching back restores 3 project cards and 3 inventory items — screens reload on focus (useFocusEffect) as intended. Final DB state: My Home is is_active=true (per main agent request); Lake Cabin=false; TEST_UI_1786152988=false. One test-created project on Lake Cabin ('Fix Leaky Faucet' from LLM titling of TEST_ActiveSwitch_Proj — status stayed 'draft' because PUT /status archived is not supported for this project) was deleted via direct mongo cleanup after tests. Only harmless RN-web warnings (shadow*→boxShadow, props.pointerEvents, expo-notifications listener on web).

minor.issue: Setting status='archived' via PUT /status appears to leave the project in the list (no 400, no removal). No dedicated DELETE endpoint exists for projects — cleanup requires status=completed or direct DB delete. Not caused by this retrofit; pre-existing behavior.

issues: Trailing helper text still reads 'Switching the active home for rooms, projects & toolbox is coming next.' — this line is now stale (feature is live). Copy update recommended.

action_items: Update stale copy on Setup & Preferences screen (`/app/frontend/app/home-intel/account/index.tsx` line ~140) — the 'coming next' note is misleading since active-home switching is live.
critical_code_review_comments: All 7 engines (project_planner, inventory, room_intelligence, home_intelligence, maintenance, document_vault, conversation_hub) implement _get_or_create_property() with the same pattern: prefer is_active=True, fallback to any, else create default. Consistent and DRY-compliant — though the helper is duplicated across 7 files. Consider extracting into a shared util (`hi_common.py`) to reduce duplication.
project_planner_engine list endpoint filters by {user_id, property_id} — good. But no `status:{$ne:'archived'}` filter, so archived projects would still appear if the archive path ever worked.
inventory_engine list filters by {user_id, property_id, status:{$ne:'archived'}} — good.

onboarding_engine.activate: updates all user's properties to is_active=false then sets target to true — atomic-enough for MVP (two ops, one collection). Documented invariant: exactly one active at a time.

maintenance and documents lists remain user-scoped (not property-scoped) — flagged as intentional by main agent. Acceptable but user-visible inconsistency (maintenance items from Lake Cabin visible while My Home is active). Consider labeling in UI later.
No 500s or regressions detected on document vault or maintenance after the retrofit.
seed_data_creation: Left demo user (demo_home@diyhomie.com) with My Home as the sole active property (3 projects, 3 toolbox items, 5 rooms, 1 asset intact). Cleaned up test residue: deleted one 'Fix Leaky Faucet' project on Lake Cabin via mongosh (status=draft, created by LLM during test_create_project_on_lake_not_visible). Test toolbox items are archived by their fixture cleanup. Lake Cabin and TEST_UI_1786152988 remain as empty comparison homes (needed for regression re-runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Active Home Switching is GREEN. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_active_home_switching.py (14 tests, idempotent — safely re-runnable). Demo user preconditions the tests need: (1) property named 'My Home' with 5 rooms + 3 projects + 3 toolbox items + >=1 asset, (2) an empty property named 'Lake Cabin'. The test fixture always restores My Home as active at the end. Endpoints of note: POST /api/hi/projects/start (NOT POST /api/hi/projects — that returns 405); POST /api/hi/chat/conversations/{cid}/message uses body {text}; /api/hi/account/properties returns {properties:[...]}, not a bare list. There is no DELETE endpoint for projects; use PUT /{project_id}/status with 'archived' or clean via mongo.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Only minor copy staleness in account screen ('coming next' phrase) — reported as action item.
